source.title: The New World Atlas of Artificial Night Sky Brightness

route_note: Landmark coordinates are editorial WGS84 points. Times Square and Central Park fall in the same >41 atlas band, so the story may discuss reduced direct glare in the park but may not claim a darker atlas band.

model_value.metric: artificial zenith sky brightness / natural sky brightness

model_implied_naked_eye_limit.method: Kyba et al. 2023 North America Eq. S3; Nn=4.95, s=-1.52

places.model_resolution: 30 arcseconds (published GeoTIFF); KMZ display tile sampled here
places.coverage_status: No local Globe at Night validation used in this package
places.evidence_type: modeled brightness band with derived NELM interval
places.caveat: A clear-sky zenith model band, not an on-site forecast. It does not resolve direct glare, obstructions, weather, moonlight, observer adaptation, or block-scale variation.
